segments.speaker: GEOFFREY
segments.en: Good evening, and in this week's edition of 'Focus on the Arts'.

segments.speaker: GEOFFREY
segments.en: Jane Hemmington is going to fill us in on what's in store for us at this year's Summer Festival.

segments.speaker: GEOFFREY
segments.en: Over to you, Jane.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: Thank you, Geoffrey.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: This year, the Summer Festival is the biggest we've ever seen, so there should be something for everybody.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: This is the third year they've run it and the timing's slightly different: for the last couple of years it's been around the fifth to seventeenth, but this year they wanted to allow everyone enough time to recover from the first of January celebrations and they've put it at the end of the month.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: The programme has sensational theatre, dance and also a large number of art exhibitions, but the thing the Festival is most famous for is its great street music.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: For today's report though, Geoffrey, I'm looking at some of . the theatrical events that you might like to see; in particular, at this year's theme-- circuses.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: I'm going to tell you about two circus performances, but there are~ of others in the programme.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: I've chosen these because they represent distinct movements within Circus performance.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: The first is the Circus Romano from Italy.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: As this is a travelling circus, it follows a long tradition by performing in a marquee - which is really like a canvas portable building, usually put up in a green space or car park, rather than in a theatre or stadium.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: In spite of this, Circus Romano isn't at all like the traditional circuses I grew up with.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: There are no animals -just very talented clowning and acrobatic routines.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: The show has a lot of very funny moments, especially at the beginning, but the best part is the music and lighting.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: They're magical.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: At forty-five dollars it's very expensive anyway- it's really for adl.l.l1 tastes.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: In fact, much of it would be wasted on children - so I suggest you leave them at home.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: The second circus performance is Circus Electrica at the Studio Theatre.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: The purists are suggesting that this isn't a circus at all.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: It's a showcase for skills in dance and magic, rather than the usual ones you expect in a circus.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: With only six performers it's a small production, which suits the venue well - the Studio only seats about two hundred people.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: For my money it's the aerial displays which are outstanding as well as the magical tricks - features which are missing from Circus Romano.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: An interesting feature of the show is that the performers are so young - the youngest is only fourteen.

segments.speaker: JANE
segments.en: But it's still well

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: a good one for the whole family.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: And finally, as it's summer, you may wish to see some of the Festival performances that are being presented outdoors.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: Like the famous Mekong Water Puppet Troupe, performing in the City Gardens this week.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: Now, water puppetry is amazing!

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: It's large puppets on long sticks, controlled by puppeteers standing waist deep in the lake.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: The puppets do comedy routines and there is some terrific formation dancing.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: This is a fantastic show and the best moment comes at the end - seeing the puppeteers.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: When the troupe walks up out of the water, you get this amazing feeling.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: It's really hard to believe that what you've been watching is lifeless wood and cloth.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: As an adult, I had a great time, but I did note that other older people in the audience weren't quite as taken with it as I was.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: It's a must for young children though, and that's the audience it's really aimed at.

segments.speaker: WORTH SEEING
segments.en: Well, that's all I've time for today, but I'll be back next week with more news of what's worth seeing and what it's best to miss.
